description: Delete managed snapshots by tag or name. Deleting one already gone succeeds. Run on the proxy.

provider.description: Provider name. Checked against the endpoint, which is authoritative.

endpoint.description: Endpoint name, or a list of them, configured on this proxy by pe_snapshot::proxy. With a list, each VM is looked up on every endpoint and must be found on exactly one.

vms.description: The VMs to act on, as certname and the vm_id from the pe_snapshot fact.

credentials.description: Credentials to merge with the proxy credentials file. A key in both is an error.

concurrency.description: How many VMs to work on at once.

tag.description: Delete managed snapshots with this tag.

name.description: Delete the managed snapshot with this name.
